snippet.title: Which Foot Goes First? 👟 The Shoe Sunnah | Islam for Kids #shorts
snippet.description:
Shoes on! But wait... which foot goes in first?

Our Prophet Muhammad-e-Mustafa (Sallallahu Ta'ala Alaihi Wa Aalihi Wasallam) taught us a lovely little sunnah: when you put your shoes on, start with the right foot, and when you take them off, start with the left. So the right foot goes in first and comes out last! (narrated by Abu Huraira Radi Allahu Anhu)

Let's practise: right shoe on, then the left. Left shoe off, then the right. Can your little one say: Right foot first!

Source
